title: Tax office threat
plain_description: A caller claims to be from a tax office and demands gift cards or crypto.
scammer_goal: Get payment in gift cards or crypto under threat.
opening_message: This is HM Revenue Notices. You owe an urgent fine. Pay with gift cards or face arrest.

easy.opening_message: Pay this tax fine in Bitcoin now or the police will come today.

hard.opening_message: I am calling from HM Revenue Notices about an unpaid notice. We can settle quietly if you buy gift cards and read the codes to me.
